rows.result: Collections and blogs lead with intro copy and FAQ blocks that answer buyer questions directly and are extractable near the top of the page.
FAQPage schema on both collection and blog templates; scannable lists/steps in guides. Genuinely AI-friendly, quotable structure — a standout.

Entity is well-defined in schema (name, logo, sameAs×5, address, contactPoint). GAP: the brand's surface name is inconsistent — 'Offlimits' (schema), 'OFF LIMITS' (title/og), 'Off Limits' (collection titles) — which can weaken entity resolution by AI engines.
